mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing, which can lead to a positive impact on the overall economy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in real GDP indicates increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
